name: commitment_drift
description: The canonical demo. Customer states Friday as a hard deadline at 00:18. At 01:42 the agent proposes Monday and the customer gives an ambiguous acceptance. Nobody ever explicitly revised the Friday constraint - the outcome changed on its own.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Let's talk timing. When do you need this delivered?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Friday is a hard deadline. Monday won't work, we have the audit that morning.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Got it. Let me check what the warehouse can do.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: And the quantity stays at two hundred units.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: So Monday delivery works for you?
